issue.body:
*You may need to run a fresh ES instance to get the latest snapshot to test this PR! :)*

This PR integrates the new follower index info ES API. Essentially, this allows:

* Follower indices in a **paused** state to surface in the UI
* Settings of **active** followers to surface in the UI

Note that there are two filed ES issues related to this API, which has affected some of this work:
* https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/37738: Follower info API doesn't return paused status
* https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/37740: Follower info API doesn't return settings for paused indices

### Table view

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1965714/51586622-d0e15e80-1e92-11e9-9bb8-13b9540cc910.png)

### Paused follower detail panel
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1965714/51586666-00906680-1e93-11e9-9a9a-57f230118052.png)

### Active follower detail panel
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1965714/51586673-08500b00-1e93-11e9-84a2-b0d6212ae8c3.png)

### Resuming a paused follower
We are not able to read a paused follower's previous settings (can only retrieve what the settings are for an **active** follower), so copy was added to reflect that "quick resume" action will resume with default settings.
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1965714/51586784-6e3c9280-1e93-11e9-8655-198713bcd1c5.png)

### Editing a paused follower
Related to above ^ Editing always implies resuming.
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1965714/51586818-82808f80-1e93-11e9-97b9-6aeaf9f90c4a.png)

### Misc

Shortcut to Index Management from context menu:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1965714/51586950-00dd3180-1e94-11e9-8b46-1c812dacdabd.png)

Display default value under each advanced setting description (similar to Kibana Advanced Settings pattern):
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1965714/51586980-19e5e280-1e94-11e9-8870-1dda17dfcc6c.png)

body: @jen-huang That is related to the bug in the issue description. Index filtering is just completely broken. I will have a PR open soon.

issue.body:
The filtering by follower index was completely broken.
Also the wrong persistent tasks were selected, causing the
wrong status to be reported.

The fix itself is small, but this PR adds more tests.

Closes #37738

Note: marking this issue as non-issue (instead of a bug), because the follow info api has not been released yet.
